# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

About Us

## Empowering Safer, Smarter Surgery

Founded more than 15 years ago in Berlin, Caresyntax began with a simple belief: surgery — one of
the most critical moments in a patient's life — deserved greater transparency, insight, and support.
While much of healthcare was becoming increasingly connected, the operating room remained largely
isolated. We believed surgical teams and patients deserved better.

What started as an effort to better understand what happens inside the operating room has grown into
a global commitment to advancing surgical care. From the beginning, our focus has been on supporting
surgeons, care teams, and hospitals with meaningful insights that help them learn, improve, and
deliver safer, more consistent care.

Over the years, we have partnered with leading hospitals, researchers, and surgical societies around
the world. Our work has contributed to peer-reviewed research in journals such as Nature Scientific
Reports, Surgical Endoscopy, and Annals of Surgery, reinforcing our dedication to evidence-based
progress in surgery.

A milestone in our journey came when the American Board of Surgery invited Caresyntax to support its
surgical coaching initiative at the American College of Surgeons Clinical Congress — a recognition
of our role in advancing surgical education and continuous improvement.

Today, Caresyntax operates globally with dual headquarters in Berlin and San Francisco. Across
thousands of operating rooms worldwide, we remain guided by the same purpose that inspired us from
the start: to make surgery smarter and safer for every patient, everywhere.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

    cancer and specialty care.

    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Who We Are

The Atlantic Urology Specialists Team is dedicated to providing cutting edge urologic care. Educated
and trained at some of the top medical schools and teaching hospitals in the nation, our Urologists
combine proficiency with exceptional skill in advanced surgical techniques.

AUS’s leading edge care and state-of-the-art technology includes **on-site radiology, laboratory &
pathology services,  ambulatory surgical centers and a clinical research branch** called Carolina
Urologic Research Center. We have a multitude of **Urologic Centers of Excellence** in and around
Horry and Georgetown counties to conveniently serve our patients.

## Who We Are

The Atlantic Urology Specialists Team is dedicated to providing cutting edge urologic care. Educated
and trained at some of the top medical schools and teaching hospitals in the nation, our Urologists
combine proficiency with exceptional skill in advanced surgical techniques.

AUS’s leading edge care and state-of-the-art technology includes **on-site radiology, laboratory &
pathology services,  ambulatory surgical centers and a clinical research branch** called Carolina
Urologic Research Center. We have a multitude of **Urologic Centers of Excellence** in and around
Horry and Georgetown counties to conveniently serve our patients.

た。ご連絡を頂戴致しまして誠にありがとうございます。

もし修正が反映されていないように見える場合、キャッシュを空にして再読み込みをお試しください。

2020年4月29日(水)

不具合を修正しました
--
谷の隙間に組みぷよが存在するとき、ある操作をすると必ず挙動がおかしくなる不具合を指摘して頂きましたの
で、それを修正致しました。詳細なご報告、誠にありがとうございました。

もし修正が反映されていないように見える場合、キャッシュを空にして再読み込みをお試しください。

2020年4月27日(月)

不具合のご指摘ありがとうございます
--
メールにて動作の不具合のケースをご指摘頂きましてありがとうございます。
確認のうえ、修正して参りたく思いますのでお待ち下さい。

2020年2月4日(火)

HTML5版のお知らせ
--
偽ぷよぷよをHTML5へ移植しました。
推奨環境はSafariです。Edgeでは少し遅く感じられるかも
しれません(今後改善していきます)。

2013年2月4日(月)

0:00 偽ぷよぷよ作業報告
--
今回のビルドでは、下記の(1)〜(4)を修正しました。

外見に現れる変更は下記の二つです。

(1)ユーザー様からのご要望にお応えし、AI-CPU版のnormalの設定を少し甘口に変更しました。
(2)くっつきの描画で、落下後の時間差があるとき不自然に見えるケースを修正しました。

また、内部的な問題として下記の二つを修正しました。

(3)まわしのテクニックによる壁越えの動作において起こりうるインデックス境界の考慮漏れを修正しました。
(4)同時消しボーナス点の加算時に起こりうる潜在的な不具合を修正しました。

以上です。

2012年8月5日(日)

14:15 偽ぷよぷよ二人用の修正作業報告
--
本日未明、ユーザ様から、『偽ぷよぷよ二人対戦フラッシュにおいて、1PがWキーを使用し、2PがCtrlキーを使
用する際Ctrl+WがIEまたはWindowsのショートカットキー(ウィンドウを消す)の割り当てになっていて不便なの
で、キーのアサインを変えて欲しい』とのご指摘を頂きました。貴重なご意見を賜り、誠にありがとうございま
す。

2Pが左回転をする時にCtrlを使用するのをやめ、スラッシュキー(/)で左回転をおこなうように変更しました。
キャッシュを消してリロードして頂くと、2Pがスラッシュキー(/)で左回転するようにした最新のビルドに差し
替わります。

現時点で左回転でスラッシュキーを使うのは二人対戦モードのみですが、1PモードとAI-CPUモードでも同様にキ
ーアサインの変更の要請等がありましたら、随時対応させて頂きます。

2012年2月8日(水)

11:00 サーバのメンテナンス完了のお知らせ
--
BIGLOBEの実施するサーバのメンテナンス作業は完了しました。

コンテンツやスコア登録用のcgi等々、すべて問題なく旧来のとおり動作することを確認しました。

2012年2月7日(火)

21:30 サーバのメンテナンスについて
--
当サイトのプロバイダ(BIGLOBE)側の実施するメンテナンス作業のため、2012年2月8日AM6:00〜AM10:00の間、一
時的に当サイトのご利用が出来なくなります。

仮に、今回のメンテナンス時間の直前からプレイして、閲覧できない時間帯にスコア登録のcgiを作動させた場
合には連動できず、せっかくの結果が正しく反映されないケースも想定されるため、上記のロスタイム(4時間程
度)の間は、ご留意を願います。

メンテナンスが終わり次第、またお知らせ致します。

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

###  200 ИМПЛАНТАЦИЙ ПОЛОВОГО ЧЛЕНА В 2025 ГОДУ

*Сегодня мы завершили 2025 года.*

*За год мы выполнили 200 имплантаций пенильных протезов.*

*Я поздравляю 🥳 всех членов команды с этим достижением и хочу поблагодарить наших пациентов за
доверие!!!*

###  184 ИМПЛАНТАЦИИ ПОЛОВОГО ЧЛЕНА В 2024 ГОДУ

Рады сообщить, в прошедшем году мы сделали 184 операции с установкой всех видов имплантов полового
члена.

**Главное: у нашей команды всего 0.5% случаев протезной инфекции.**

Такого результата удалось добиться благодаря тотальному контролю за чистотой операционной, слаженной
работы команды, запатентованным методом сборки имплантов.

* [Диета][141]

* [Утренняя эрекция][144]

### 161 операция про протезированию пинальных имплантов

Доктор Меньщиков сделал 161 операцию в 2023 году. Это очередной рекорд в Восточной Европе.

### Более 130 операций

### [Интервью с доктором Меньщиковым][147]

*«Имплантация полового члена – это дорогостоящая хирургическая операция, которую в России выполняет
лишь несколько человек. В России производят всего 150 имплантаций в год и около 100 из них делает
один человек. В этом выпуске я взял интервью именно у этого человека.»*

Евгений Кесарев

### Операции в Турции и Сербии

Рады сообщить: с июня 2022 года доктор Меньщиков будет проводить операции в Стамбуле и Белграде.
Информацию уточняйте по телефону

### Приём в Ильинской больнице

С апреля 2022 года: Меньщиков Константин Анатольевич открыл дополнительный приём в Ильинской
больнице. Доступны консультации и все виды операций.

### 100 имплантаций в год

9 октября прошла 100-я операция по имплантации полового члена  в 2021 году под руководством
Константина Анатольевича Меньщикова.

**Это рекорд по количеству таких операций в Восточной Европе.**

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,

# Nocturol, Inc.

Today about 2.4 billion people have their sleep interrupted frequently by the need to urinate, a
medical condition known as [nocturia.][12]  For some it is not a big bother, but for hundreds of
millions of people who visit the bathroom multiple times per night, this can be a very troubling and
sometimes dangerous condition.

Learn more about[ nocturia.][13]

[ABOUT US][14]

# Our Focus

The focus of Nocturol, Inc. is to help people sleep better with fewer or no interruptions due to the
urge to urinate periodically throughout the night.

We are currently in development of [Nocturol™][15] (also known as Paxerol^{®}), a treatment for
nocturia in order to reduce these bathroom visits and enable a more peaceful and healthy sleep.

# Nocturol, Inc.

Sleep Undisturbed

Nocturol, Inc. inhibits the overproduction of prostaglandins with a low dose combination of
acetaminophen and ibuprofen in an extended release formulation. For those who suffer from frequent
nightly bathroom trips, Nocturol is designed to provide 8 hours of protection with one nightly
tablet.

[LEARN MORE][16]

# Our Goal Pipeline

[LEARN MORE][17]

# Research & Development

A Breakthrough Leading to Big Impact

The Phase 2 double-blinded clinical trial of Nocturol, Inc. conducted in New York City and Long
Island, NY was recently concluded with record setting results and no side effects reported.

[LEARN MORE][18]

# Our Science

Has Identified The Key

Our science has unlocked the key to inhibiting prostaglandins through a synergistic combination of
acetaminophen and NSAIDs.  Ibuprofen inhibits production at the COX site and acetaminophen inhibits
production at the POX site, both within the COX1/2 enzymes.

## Pelvic Health Conditions We Help

## You’re in good hands.

We’re driven by research based on solid evidence. And our focus is totally centred on you. At Pelvic
Health Matters, we take the time to understand all your concerns. Of course,  sometimes, they can be
very intimate. (And we’re totally ok with that, too.) We also take the time to really understand
your pelvic health concerns and what might be driving them – whether it be physical, emotional or
lifestyle. And with everyone, it’s different.

Rest assured, you’ll only ever have private, one-on-one sessions with a caring, understanding and
highly qualified postgraduate Pelvic Health Physio. After working together, you’ll  have a
personalised treatment plan, entirely centred on you. Because at the end of the day, you are what
matters most to us.

###### ``Extensive Experience

No matter how simple or complex your pelvic health condition, you’re in the right place. With over
30 years of experience, we deliver the expert physiotherapy care you can trust.

###### Proven Pathway

Our unique 3-step pathway takes the time to truly listen and understand because pelvic health is
rarely one-dimensional. This approach gives you the greatest opportunity to live your best life.

###### Cutting-Edge Care

We’re committed to lifelong learning and the latest research. This means you’ll always receive the
most current and effective physiotherapy treatment, personalised to your needs.

###### Positive Partnerships

There’s nothing like the power of positive relationships. We believe that better outcomes happen
when everyone’s on the same page, so we’ll work closely with you and your health professionals.

###### Empathetic Empowerment

You’ll feel safe, supported and understood because empathy guides everything we do. We’ll help you
rebuild hope and confidence, empowering you to take control of your pelvic health and your future.

## What is Pelvic Health Physiotherapy?
## (and other FAQs)

Pelvic health physiotherapy focuses specifically on supporting people experiencing pelvic health
conditions across all life stages. These include bladder and bowel frequency, urgency and poor
control, constipation, pelvic organ prolapse, pelvic and sexual pain, pre and post pelvic surgery
and a range of symptoms during pregnancy and post birth. Pelvic Health Physiotherapists should have
completed specific training in this area, with our minimum requirement being
postgraduate-qualifications.

[**See more FAQs >**][141]

## Pelvic Health Conditions We Help

## You’re in good hands.

We’re driven by research based on solid evidence. And our focus is totally centred on you. At Pelvic
Health Matters, we take the time to understand all your concerns. Of course,  sometimes, they can be
very intimate. (And we’re totally ok with that, too.) We also take the time to really understand
your pelvic health concerns and what might be driving them – whether it be physical, emotional or
lifestyle. And with everyone, it’s different.

Rest assured, you’ll only ever have private, one-on-one sessions with a caring, understanding and
highly qualified postgraduate Pelvic Health Physio. After working together, you’ll  have a
personalised treatment plan, entirely centred on you. Because at the end of the day, you are what
matters most to us.

###### ``Extensive Experience

No matter how simple or complex your pelvic health condition, you’re in the right place. With over
30 years of experience, we deliver the expert physiotherapy care you can trust.

###### Proven Pathway

Our unique 3-step pathway takes the time to truly listen and understand because pelvic health is
rarely one-dimensional. This approach gives you the greatest opportunity to live your best life.

###### Cutting-Edge Care

We’re committed to lifelong learning and the latest research. This means you’ll always receive the
most current and effective physiotherapy treatment, personalised to your needs.

###### Positive Partnerships

There’s nothing like the power of positive relationships. We believe that better outcomes happen
when everyone’s on the same page, so we’ll work closely with you and your health professionals.

###### Empathetic Empowerment

You’ll feel safe, supported and understood because empathy guides everything we do. We’ll help you
rebuild hope and confidence, empowering you to take control of your pelvic health and your future.

## What is Pelvic Health Physiotherapy?
## (and other FAQs)

Pelvic health physiotherapy focuses specifically on supporting people experiencing pelvic health
conditions across all life stages. These include bladder and bowel frequency, urgency and poor
control, constipation, pelvic organ prolapse, pelvic and sexual pain, pre and post pelvic surgery
and a range of symptoms during pregnancy and post birth. Pelvic Health Physiotherapists should have
completed specific training in this area, with our minimum requirement being
postgraduate-qualifications.

[**See more FAQs >**][141]

### New name.
### Same exceptional care.

Formerly known as Women’s & Men’s Health Physiotherapy, our new name reflects both what we believe
in and what we do. We have an unwavering belief that pelvic health matters for everyone, at every
stage of life.

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder

business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

segment opportunities.

where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is

Compassionate care with the latest urological technology

## State of the Art Surgery Center

Surgical Center for Urology is licensed by the State of Georgia, certified by Medicare and
accredited by AAAHC
 

[ Learn More ][102]

## [5 LOCATIONS IN GEORGIA
## 
## ][103]

Our urologist team operates out of five offices and a surgical center to serve the needs of all
Northern Georgia residents 

[ Learn More ][104]

## [QUALIFIED DOCTORS][105]

Our team is comprised of some of Atlanta’s most accomplished doctors who are all board certified and
members of the American Urological Association.

[ Learn More ][106]

side when you are having difficult times."

# Dr Karen McKertich, Urology Surgeon in Melbourne

Submitted by urineincontinence on Tue, 2014-11-18 05:59

Specialist Diagnosis, Treatment and Advice about Urinary Incontinence and Female Urology.

Dr Karen McKertich’s area of interest, sub-specialisation and passion is the treatment of adults
with urinary incontinence and bladder problems with a special interest in adult Female Urology and
pelvic floor abnormalities including prolapse.

This website features detailed information about some of the conditions treated by Dr Karen
McKertich and aims to educate patients and their families about Urinary Incontinence, Female Urology
and other bladder conditions.

## An experienced urologist treating both males and females

Many women and men suffer from [urinary incontinence][27] and other bladder symptoms. It’s often not
easy to talk about problems that are personal and embarrassing, but it is the first step in getting
help. Urinary incontinence and bladder problems can be treated, often cured and almost always
managed better with an improvement in quality of life.

Dr Karen McKertich offers assessment and treatment of a variety of urological conditions as a
urologist in Melbourne, including [overactive bladder][28] and [stress incontinence][29]. She is
dedicated to improving quality of life for those whose life is impacted by a urological condition.

### About our urology clinic

Our clinic is located in the main rooms of the Australian Urology Associates at Ground Floor, 322
Glenferrie Road in Malvern. While there is no on-site parking, free street parking is readily
available close by. The clinic is also easily accessible by public transport.

If you would like to find out more about [incontinence surgery][30], our urology surgeon or enquire
about a booking, please don’t hesitate to give us a call on **03 8506 3643**. Otherwise, [send us an
online enquiry][31] and we’ll get back to you as soon as we are able.

**Opening Hours**

Monday to Friday: 9:00am – 5:00pm
*Closed on weekends and public holidays.*

## About Dr Karen McKertich

Dr Karen McKertich is a Urological Surgeon specialising in the assessment and treatment of urinary
incontinence, bladder problems, and Female Urology including prolapse.

Karen graduated top of her year in Medicine at the University of Melbourne in 1991. She completed
Urological training in Australia and obtained her Fellowship in Urological Surgery from the Royal
Australasian College of Surgeons (RACS) in 2000.

# Urology Specialists of Austin is reinventing what it’s like to visit a urologist

At Urology Specialists of Austin, we are proud to be one of the largest and most experienced urology
groups in Austin. Our size means our Austin urologists can offer you more state-of-the-art urology
services, personalized attention and holistic care that addresses every part of your body as well as
your mind.  Our doctors and providers know that the last place that most people want to be is a
doctor’s office. However, if you’re envisioning dealing with stuffy doctors and cold hands on
sensitive areas, you’ll be pleasantly surprised by your visit to Urology Specialists of Austin.

Five board certified medical doctors and eight advanced practice providers call our urology practice
home. Not only have our Austin urology providers had years of training and have a combined 135+
years of experience, but they’re also fun, friendly and personable. We know that you might be coming
to visit us to get help for an unpleasant problem, so we strive to make your visit with us as
pleasant as possible. If you don’t think that can happen, you just haven’t visited our doctors yet.

[Urology Specialists of Austin. Round Rock, Dripping Springs, South Austin, North Austin]

Central Texas

[Meet Our Providers][194]

### You can find all the urology services you need

### *under one roof*

Few things are more annoying than getting a diagnosis for a health problem, only to find out you
have to go somewhere else to get treatment for it. Our Austin urologists work hard to make sure that
never happens. We offer a full range of services for urology for men and women, including some
brand-new, state-of-the-art treatment options you probably haven’t even heard of yet.

Whether you need HIFU to beat prostate cancer into submission, or you need help with a condition
like low T, kidney stones or erectile dysfunction, our team has you covered. We also offer urology
services for women and holistic care options like nutrition counseling for everyone.

[Learn More About Us][195]
[Contact Us][196]

So, what are you waiting for? We can’t wait to help you overcome issues in the bed, bath and beyond.
[Contact us][197] to schedule a consultation at one of our locations, including Round Rock, North
Austin, South Austin and Dripping Springs.

## Our Services

[Women’s Health Icon]

## Urology for Women

Men aren’t the only ones who sometimes need a little help from our Austin urologists. Whether you
want to reignite the spark in the bedroom or be leak-free when you laugh or sneeze, our urologists
can help.

[Sperm Icon]

## Male Fertility and Vasectomy Reversal

Women aren’t the only ones who can face infertility. You can find treatments that help your little
swimmers get where they need to go. We can also help if you change your mind after getting the snip.

[Kidney Stone Icon]

## Kidney Stones

Even Dwight Schrute from The Office couldn’t treat his own kidney stones, so why should you? Our
Austin urologists use state-of-the-art tools to diagnose and treat these little pains in the urinary
track.

[Erectile Dysfunction Icon]

## Erectile Dysfunction

Trouble getting it up can happen at any age, but you don’t have to just live with it. Our board
certified urologists offer treatments, including shockwave therapy, that are worthy of a stiff and
standing ovation.

## What Makes Us Better

[Smiling older couple lies on grass with heads propped on hands, exuding warmth and happiness. Lush
greenery and soft light create a serene atmosphere.]

**No two patients (or penises) are alike**

## Customized Approach to Care

No two patients (or penises) are alike, so we believe that each patient should have a customized
treatment plan. And treatment doesn’t necessarily mean surgery because even our surgeons know that
surgical procedures don’t solve all problems.

[Read More][198]
[Studio Microphone Recording Podcast Audio]

**The Armor Men’s Health Podcast**

## Passion for Podcasting

Talking about sensitive subjects is literally just another day at the office for our Austin
urologists, which is why we started a podcast. The Armor Men’s Health Podcast doesn’t shy away from
any topic, no matter how big or small.

[Find Out More][199]

photo]

# Urology Specialists of Austin is reinventing what it’s like to visit a urologist

At Urology Specialists of Austin, we are proud to be one of the largest and most experienced urology
groups in Austin. Our size means our Austin urologists can offer you more state-of-the-art urology
services, personalized attention and holistic care that addresses every part of your body as well as
your mind.  Our doctors and providers know that the last place that most people want to be is a
doctor’s office. However, if you’re envisioning dealing with stuffy doctors and cold hands on
sensitive areas, you’ll be pleasantly surprised by your visit to Urology Specialists of Austin.

Five board certified medical doctors and eight advanced practice providers call our urology practice
home. Not only have our Austin urology providers had years of training and have a combined 135+
years of experience, but they’re also fun, friendly and personable. We know that you might be coming
to visit us to get help for an unpleasant problem, so we strive to make your visit with us as
pleasant as possible. If you don’t think that can happen, you just haven’t visited our doctors yet.

### You can find all the urology services you need

### *under one roof*

Few things are more annoying than getting a diagnosis for a health problem, only to find out you
have to go somewhere else to get treatment for it. Our Austin urologists work hard to make sure that
never happens. We offer a full range of services for urology for men and women, including some
brand-new, state-of-the-art treatment options you probably haven’t even heard of yet.

Whether you need HIFU to beat prostate cancer into submission, or you need help with a condition
like low T, kidney stones or erectile dysfunction, our team has you covered. We also offer urology
services for women and holistic care options like nutrition counseling for everyone.

[Learn More About Us][195]
[Contact Us][196]

So, what are you waiting for? We can’t wait to help you overcome issues in the bed, bath and beyond.
[Contact us][197] to schedule a consultation at one of our locations, including Round Rock, North
Austin, South Austin and Dripping Springs.

## Our Services

[Women’s Health Icon]

## Urology for Women

Men aren’t the only ones who sometimes need a little help from our Austin urologists. Whether you
want to reignite the spark in the bedroom or be leak-free when you laugh or sneeze, our urologists
can help.

[Sperm Icon]

## Male Fertility and Vasectomy Reversal

Women aren’t the only ones who can face infertility. You can find treatments that help your little
swimmers get where they need to go. We can also help if you change your mind after getting the snip.

[Kidney Stone Icon]

## Kidney Stones

Even Dwight Schrute from The Office couldn’t treat his own kidney stones, so why should you? Our
Austin urologists use state-of-the-art tools to diagnose and treat these little pains in the urinary
track.

[Erectile Dysfunction Icon]

## Erectile Dysfunction

Trouble getting it up can happen at any age, but you don’t have to just live with it. Our board
certified urologists offer treatments, including shockwave therapy, that are worthy of a stiff and
standing ovation.

## What Makes Us Better

[Smiling older couple lies on grass with heads propped on hands, exuding warmth and happiness. Lush
greenery and soft light create a serene atmosphere.]

**No two patients (or penises) are alike**

## Customized Approach to Care

No two patients (or penises) are alike, so we believe that each patient should have a customized
treatment plan. And treatment doesn’t necessarily mean surgery because even our surgeons know that
surgical procedures don’t solve all problems.

## Passion for Podcasting

Talking about sensitive subjects is literally just another day at the office for our Austin
urologists, which is why we started a podcast. The Armor Men’s Health Podcast doesn’t shy away from
any topic, no matter how big or small.
